doc: One record per current OpenRouter model with tools and >= 128K context (free and stealth first, then by id): id, family, free, stealth, tools, context, max_output, open_weights (Hugging Face id or null), listed, screen (status try = a public score at its board's bar or open weights that fit a local tier, skip = no reliable tool endpoint, watch = neither, unscreened = a source unreadable or out of scope; reason; each part with its source and fetch time). Refreshed daily by the homelab lead-scout; fetch https://raw.githubusercontent.com/akapug/homelab-atlas/main/watch/model-watch.json
